The suspension of Ryan Gravenberch and possible absence of Dominik Szoboszlai has left Liverpool short in midfield. But even if the Hungarian makes it, Trey Nyoni should keep his place with Alexis Mac Allister joining him at the base of the engine room and Szoboszlai the number 10.

Up front, hat-trick hero Bradley Barcola is on the left, Lewis Koumas can stay down the middle with Rio Ngumoha going again on the right.
